title: TRIAD185-TAGBANK: exact peer TRIAD recycling with linear ordinary classical storage, T/SQ/Q exp(5sqrt(n)/4)

claims.statement: For the single uniform TRIAD185-TAGBANK physical algorithm supplied completely in proof.md and virtual.md (same complete published TRIAD-125 source/instrument/schedule/caps/decoders,streaming finite tester for n<2^28;otherwise publicu=ceil(156ceil(sqrt n)/125)+2,U=2^u,A=2^16n²,R=2^128n64U,Wrow=2^16n²,H=2^96n64U,e=(n+2)^20 and counted full bitbank/unknown-wire/CQ implementation),for every N>=2 and s modulo N,n=ceil(log2N),unconditional ENTIRE-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least1-2^-7 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERYbranch T=O(2^((5/4)*sqrt n)),ordinary classicalS_C=O(n),full allocatedS_Q=O(2^((5/4)*sqrt n)),and total acquisitionsQ=O(2^((5/4)*sqrt n)),including every failure,discard,partialattempt,retry,guard,abort,full address debit,initialization,source transfer,lifecycle,finite exactepoch repair and cleanup. All exponent coefficients are exactly5/4 and outsideconstants absolute. The time upper envelope has exactindex1/2.
